summary: SEALSQ Corp filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Series A investment agreement to acquire a minority interest in Quobly SAS, a quantum-computing R&D company, for EUR 14,999,400. The consideration is cash for Series A preferred shares with broad-based anti-dilution ratchet warrants valid for four years. Closing occurred on June 2, 2026. SEALSQ received a board seat with veto rights over major actions. No premium or break fee stated. As a minority investment, not a full acquisition. Watch for Quobly’s future pricing rounds that could trigger warrant adjustments.
